rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for an apron worn to protect clothing while cooking or doing other messy work.

example.english: Remember to wear an apron when cooking, so you don't dirty your clothes.
example.traditional: 煮飯嗰陣記得着圍裙，唔好整污糟件衫。
example.jyutping: zyu2 faan6 go2 zan6 gei3 dak1 zoek3 wai4 kwan4 m4 hou2 zing2 wu1 zou1 gin6 saam1
